Cinematic pitch: sources, rights inventory and review limits

Review date: November 9, 2026 · Independent professional review: PENDING

Pitch · Treatment · Collaboration case · Machine-readable inventory

Source classes

Owner-supplied foundation is distinct from independently inspected evidence. Project source verified means a repository artifact was read, not that its underlying rights are cleared. Official-source context establishes what the organization publicly says, not a contract or endorsement. Proposal and unresolved must not become facts through presentation.

Legal and platform sources

Use the existing AI-MUSIC-001 source verification and Legal & Rights register for Title 17, separate composition/master rights, human AI authorship, transfers and platform distinctions. Those are existing educational cases, not clearance for this project.

Suno terms were rechecked November 9, 2026: revision August 10, 2026; effective September 3, 2026. Relevant provisions are Using the Service, Pro/Premier, Basic, Remixes and Permitted Commercial Use. The precise existing recording's plan, feature, generation date, inputs, permitted Download and buyer acceptance remain unverified. No private account was accessed. A paid subscription or new mix is not a substitute for input and underlying-rights review.

The proposed Paul Simon source question needs authorized session and version investigation. No protected sound was downloaded, reproduced, analyzed or simulated to decide it here. No infringement, misconduct, breach, damage amount or legal approval is asserted.

Asset and rights inventory

  • Pitch artwork: original typographic/line/space composition authored in HTML/CSS for this review. No portraits, artist logos, third-party performance, soundtrack, footage or AI-generated celebrity imagery.
  • Fonts: existing Georgia/system reading stack and self-hosted Fraunces already in this repository; existing SIL OFL license. No new font download or dependency.
  • PIXIE: existing companion sigil, unchanged, with provenance in brand-guidelines.md; link to the existing Companion/guide, no new character or assistant.
  • Real recording/master, Suno interpretation and all new music options: unresolved for specified commercial/sync use; Hold until version-specific evidence and competent review. “Verified” in the inventory is a fact-check label, not clearance.
  • Fictional series: owner-supplied premise; original expression and title chain still require normal private documentation. Detailed arcs/art direction here are proposals pending owner acceptance.
  • Private evidence: no raw correspondence, personal financial records, identifying studio details, private Drive links, negotiations or unpublished protected recordings included.

Review and publication boundaries

Draft Vercel preview and draft PR only. Owner visual, premise and public-history acceptance are still required before merging. Legal/technical holds are in the checklist; validation record distinguishes automated/local/preview evidence from physical-device and legal acceptance. PIXIE OAuth PR #12 and Training Library PR #55 remain open at their existing held commits; no capability is activated.

Download Markdown source · Presentation does not indicate legal review or clearance. See the document's stated status.
